rules.title: Offences police cannot release on a police bond
rules.text: Only the High Court can grant bail for this offence. Refer the file to the DPP and keep the person in custody.
rules.note: Working list written by the Pleadli team from general knowledge. It has no citation yet and has not been reviewed by a legal officer. Treat a refusal as a prompt to check, and have this list confirmed.

rules.title: What to do when a juvenile is brought in
rules.text: Keep the child apart from adults. Tell a parent or guardian. Inform the Probation and Social Welfare Officer. Confirm with a legal officer which time limit and court apply.
rules.note: General guidance, not a statement of the exact legal steps. Needs review and a citation.
